competency_fulfillment.rationale: The samples successfully test the ability to solve word problems involving division. For instance, questions like "Marco has ₱180 and wants to share it equally among 2 friends." explicitly require the student to perform division to find the solution.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The competency specifies dividing 2- to 3-digit numbers by 1-digit numbers, including money. The samples cover 2-digit dividends ("42 costumes", "30 ribbons"), 3-digit dividends ("230 eggs", "657 milk tea cups"), 1-digit divisors ("2 friends", "5 eggs"), and explicitly include money problems ("₱180", "₱936", "₱738").

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The word problems are written with accessible vocabulary and clear contexts appropriate for Grade 3 students. Phrases like "share it equally among" and "put in each bag" are standard and easily comprehensible division structures for this level.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The packet provides a good mix of partitive division ("share 42 costumes equally among 2 friends") and quotitive division ("5 eggs are put in each bag, how many bags are needed?"). It also utilizes various formats including multiple-choice, true/false, and error detection.

competency_alignment.rationale: All questions align strictly with the target competency. No extraneous concepts are introduced; each sample focuses purely on solving a division problem with the specified constraints (2-to-3 digits by 1 digit).

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The numerical scale perfectly adheres to the limits set by the competency. All dividends are either 2-digit (e.g., 42, 30, 60) or 3-digit (e.g., 180, 230, 114, 936), and all divisors are strictly 1-digit (e.g., 2, 4, 5, 9).
